summary: Iter21 retest of the iter20 minor: verified list_vacancies now always adds $nin:['admit_card','result'] unless category is explicitly one of those. Ran the existing iter20 pytest (8/8 PASS — including the previously-lenient haryana test which just checks 200) AND authored a stricter iter21 pytest that asserts zero admit_card/result leakage in every requested view. All 15 tests pass, including the specifically-requested test_vacancy_category_haryana_no_admit_result. Fix confirmed.

server.py is still 1494+ lines — recommend splitting into routers (vacancies, auth, admin, seo, content) for maintainability (carried over from iter20).

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter21 pytest is the authoritative regression for the admit_card/result exclusion behaviour. Rerun /app/backend/tests/test_vacancies_iter21.py alongside iter20 to guard against future regressions. Key invariants asserted: (a) category=haryana|delhi|<any-non-admit/result> never returns items where category in {admit_card,result}; (b) category=admit_card returns only admit_card; category=result returns only result; (c) stats.by_mode.all == stats.total (job-view total) and both by_category entries for admit_card/result are still present in stats.
rca of the issue: Iter20 root cause: list_vacancies only applied the $nin exclusion inside the `else` branch (category None/'all'), so category='haryana' hit the $or dict-category branch without the guard, leaking admit_card/result. Fix: exclusion is now added unconditionally unless the requested category IS 'admit_card' or 'result'. Verified via test_vacancy_category_haryana_no_admit_result which returned 0 leaks (was 2 in iter20).
